output.name: Streakly
output.description: Miss a day? Repair it. Streakly lets you make up a missed day within the week so your streak survives real life. Weekly targets replace daily guilt. Everything stays private on-device — no accounts, no social feed, no shame spiral.
output.first_comment:
Hey Product Hunt! I'm the maker of Streakly, and I built it because I kept deleting my own habit apps.

The pattern was always the same: miss one day → streak gone → motivation gone → app deleted. I figured I wasn't uniquely weak-willed, so I looked at the research. Turns out rigid daily chains are a pretty fragile motivation system for most people.

So Streakly works differently. Miss a day? Double up somewhere else in the week and your streak survives. Habits are scored against weekly targets, not unbroken daily chains. And everything lives on your device — no account, no leaderboard, no one watching.

We've been in TestFlight with 800 people. 41% are still tracking at day 30, and the reviews are sitting at 4.8 stars across 96 responses. The most-requested feature from early testers was streak repair — so we made it the core mechanic, not a paid add-on.

Honest limitations: iOS only for now (no Android, sorry), the website is basically a waitlist page, and our retention numbers are self-reported from one cohort — take them with appropriate salt.

Would love your feedback, especially: Does the weekly-target model feel intuitive on first use? And is the repair mechanic clear enough without a tutorial? Thanks for checking it out 🙏
warnings: App Store listing is still in review at time of writing — confirm it is live before submitting to Product Hunt.
Retention stats (41% at day 30) are self-reported from a single TestFlight cohort and have not been independently verified. The first_comment discloses this honestly.
No Android version exists; ensure the listing clearly states iOS only to avoid negative reviews from Android users.
